video_title: Ced Ceballos Explains His Controversial Steph Curry Comments

quotes.speaker: Ced Ceballos
quotes.summary_phrase: Ced Ceballos on the lack of financial literacy in his era
quotes.excerpt: I never understood how I love Kareem and how Kareem fell through money troubles and Magic.
quotes.quote: I just wish the communication with funds and money between players was more prevalent. I never understood how I love Kareem and how Kareem fell through money troubles and Magic. And just like with Mike and then Scottie went through money troubles. With Mike, that's your counter. That's your Batman and Robin. When you grab him, you're like, 'Yo, check this out, I'm about to do this, that, and the other.' Sometimes it's just, I wish that we as a unit we did that a little bit more. We do it now after we get out the game, but when we're in it, we should do more because we can do it.

quotes.speaker: Ced Ceballos
quotes.summary_phrase: Ced Ceballos on how player salaries impact locker room dynamics
quotes.excerpt: I got criticized about Curry not being able to do what he did in my era.
quotes.quote: I think that's the difference in the play of the game, too. I got criticized about Curry not being able to do what he did in my era because you got Oakleys and Masons and Buck Williams that are making 100,000 and you're making what you're making and you shoot a 50-footer. You get touched up in the locker room. You know what I'm saying? I know y'all have Magic on here a lot, he talk about that. People getting in the fights with each other and Oakley slapping the shit out of them and all that. They because the dollar amount. So if I'm making 60 to 80, shoot that shit, Steph. I don't give a fuck. I'm making 60 to 80. I don't have to lose teeth to make what those guys was making.

quotes.speaker: Ced Ceballos
quotes.summary_phrase: Ced Ceballos on how NIL money impacts college basketball
quotes.excerpt: I thought NIL would fuck up college because if Matt is at UCLA making two million.
quotes.quote: I thought NIL would fuck up college because if Matt is at UCLA making two million and I'm eating top ramen, I'm taking Matt out. I'm a college player. I'm taking Matt out because I'm starving and this dude is in a Bentley. And he going to still get his two million, but now I get to play a little bit more and maybe I'm not starving no more.

quotes.speaker: Ced Ceballos
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on how NIL money changes player motivation
quotes.excerpt: The effort and just the passion to want to be great or to eat what you kill.
quotes.quote: The money's made even before now, even before you get to the NBA. They going to the NBA with four or five million from NIL. So now like the effort and just the passion to want to be great or to eat what you kill, you don't have that attitude no more. You already ate.

quotes.speaker: Ced Ceballos
quotes.summary_phrase: Ced Ceballos on the Lakers' financial and cultural dominance
quotes.excerpt: Our year is going to always be the year to make the most money.
quotes.quote: Our year is going to always be the year to make the most money, and that's what we going to do every year. We ain't got one since '95 and we still the most expensive team, the most followed team. You know, like when they play here, it's so fire in LA. It's going to be a home game.

quotes.speaker: Ced Ceballos
quotes.summary_phrase: Ced Ceballos on the Lakers' home-court advantage in opposing arenas
quotes.excerpt: We only got booed one place running out that tunnel and that was Boston.
quotes.quote: The wonderful thing and it's shocking when I got traded to the LA for the Lakers is we only got booed one place running out that tunnel and that was Boston. That was the only place. And this is before Sacramento had the beef for Phil and the cowbells and all that. So we play Sacramento, it's a home game. We play Golden State, it's a home game. We play Phoenix, we play any of, it's a home game for the Lakers, man. It's crazy.

quotes.speaker: Ced Ceballos
quotes.summary_phrase: Ced Ceballos on his first meeting with Larry Bird
quotes.excerpt: He turned to Paul Westphal and was like, 'You got to be fucking kidding me.'
quotes.quote: I check in the game. I'm not supposed to guard Larry, but I'm in the garden. I'm speaking to fucking Larry fucking Bird. So I went up and, 'How you doing, man?' And he had his hand on his hip and he turned to Paul Westphal and was like, 'You got to be fucking kidding me. I know you ain't got this motherfucker guard me.' I was like, 'So, I'm going to guard somebody else over here.'
